description: Submit a same-host crawl as an asynchronous job and return a job_id immediately. When to use: you need more than a couple of pages and cannot hold a long HTTP request; submit here, then poll web_crawl_job until status is done, failed or cancelled. Do not use: for one page (web_fetch) or when you need the result in this call (web_crawl). Returns: {ok, job_id, status, url, depth, max_pages, max_chars, idempotent, poll_with}. Pass idempotency_key to retry safely (24h window returns the same job). Metered: shares the web free bucket (100 calls/day per IP), then 3 credits per submit over x402.

idempotency_key.description: Optional; retries within 24h return the same job.

name: web_crawl_async
title: Web Crawl Async
